mapper.insert: insert into promotion_rule(rule_name, rule_content, remark) values (#{ruleName}, #{ruleContent}, #{remark})
mapper.select: select rule_id as ruleId, rule_name as ruleName from promotion_rule

select count(*) from promotion_rule r
r.rule_name like concat('%', #{ruleName}, '%')
select rule_id as ruleId, rule_name as ruleName, rule_content as ruleContent, remark from promotion_rule where rule_id = #{ruleId} limit 1
